archimate:CourseOfAction.name: 6. Standardising the way we deliver projects and embedding a set standard​
archimate:CourseOfAction.documentation:
Every project and programme will have a single, consistent set of delivery standards, so people have a more reliable, streamlined way of working.​
Not a priority pre-Christmas – design activity planned for January – March. Initial standards may be identified during ‘post contract’ component of the end-to-end pipeline. ​
Level 2 capabilities are: Account and contract management ​ Portfolio, programme and project management ​ Operations oversight​ Operational risk management ​ Pipeline development ​ Strategic prioritisation and triage ​
